item.title: Routinely Itemised: RPG #350
item.description: D&D digital hiring, Kickstarter layoffs and a Paizo leak. Catch up on the latest in the world of roleplaying games in this week's Routinely Itemised.

item.title: Atlas Imprecatis: Create your own ritualistic urban legend
item.description: Atlas Imprecatis is a collaborative horror roleplaying game about ritualistic urban legends. Build your own myth using the No Dice No Masters system.

item.title: Mists of Akuma: Eastern fantasy, noir, and steampunk for 5E
item.description: Enter a world of Eastern fantasy, steampunk, and noir. The Mists of Akuma bundle offers a massive D&D 5E campaign setting of corrupted fog, warring clans, and dark magic.

item.title: Audio EXP #323: Digital Shifts, Red Dwarf Tributes, and Akira Returns
item.description: From a mythic hexcrawl in Wolves Upon the Coast to Akira returning to IMAX screens, Girdy breaks down the biggest geek culture news of the week.

item.title: Help independent news: Pick April’s RPG Publisher Spotlight
item.description: Open Sesame Games wins the March 2026 Spotlight as Patrons begin voting for April’s featured indie roleplaying games publisher.

item.title: Why the MoD is using Elite Dangerous writers to plan for 2122
item.description: The UK MoD has partnered with Coventry University and writer Dr Allen Stroud to create Creative Futures, a sci-fi anthology used to predict the next 100 years of war.

item.title: François Baranger returns to the abyss with an illustrated The Shadow over Innsmouth
item.description: Discover how Free League and François Baranger are recontextualising The Shadow over Innsmouth through the "Swedish Wave" of horror and cinematic art.

item.title: Pokémon Day 2026: A retail triumph for Forbidden Planet’s community hubs
item.description: Forbidden Planet reports record crowds for Pokémon Day 2026, but is it the official hub fans expect? We investigate the divide between retail hype and TCG reality.

item.title: Tales from the Tape Deck: The music-driven roleplaying game that fits in a cassette case
item.description: Suffety Games brings Tales from the Tape Deck to Kickstarter. This rules lite roleplaying game fits in a cassette case and uses a music playlist as a game timer.

item.title: Numenera: Strand short film returns as The Amber Archive eclipses original 2012 funding
item.description: The Ninth World returns in Numenera: The Amber Archive. Explore the mechanical shift to the Cypher System and the 10-year legacy of the stunning Strand short film.
